title: review-claims.json (the canonical author claims for a change)
description: The canonical record of what the author says the change does, under .dabbler/runs/<set>/s<N>/critique/<change-id>/review-claims.json. This file — not any Markdown rendering of it — is the artifact code reads. A human-readable twin may be generated for people and is never parsed; deleting the twin changes no behavior. The repository's end-of-set change-log.md is a different artifact with a different owner and is not overloaded for this purpose.

schema_version.description: Frozen at v1. A reader that finds any other value refuses the record rather than interpreting it.

claims.description: May be empty: a change whose author claims nothing is a valid input, and is not the same as a missing claims file.

statement.description: One assertion about the change, in the author's words.
